name: Hsino Tower Group Co., Ltd.
summary: Hsino Tower Group Co., Ltd. engages research, development, production, and sale of transmission line towers and voltage level structures. The company produces and sells transmission line towers comprising of, steel pipe towers, steel pipe poles, transformer substation supports, communication towers, steel components, and hot-dip galvanizing anti-corrosion structures. It also offers angle steel towers, steel tube towers, steel tube poles, and transformer structure supports. In addition, the company is involved in construction, import and export of goods, and technology import and export related operations. Hsino Tower Group Co., Ltd. was founded in 1985 and is based in Jinan, China.
